capabilities: Publish Markdown notes to Feishu/Lark Docs
Bind notes to existing remote documents
Attach local files as native cards
Log publish and sync results locally
disambiguation: Despite 'sync' in the name, it is one-way only: Obsidian to Feishu/Lark, and remote edits do not come back.
extras: Installation is not one-click: build from source with npm ci and npm run build, then copy main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css into the plugin folder, or run the included install.sh. Git pre-push does not upload attachments, and .feishuignore rules do not apply to manual single-note sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to Feishu/Lark Docs or keep a shared remote document updated as the local note changes.
summary: Publisher that sends Markdown notes, folders, and PDFs to Feishu/Lark Docs and keeps them in sync via the local lark-cli.
